title: Volume Rebate Program Terms and Ladders of the Contract Pricing Agreement
content:
# Volume rebate program terms

The Contract Pricing Agreement earns a quarterly volume rebate only on a tier whose rebate row below reads Yes. These terms state, per tier, the ladder, what counts as qualifying spend, the payout timing, methods and minimum, and whether returns or an early termination reduce the rebate.

Columns, lowest tier to highest: **Account Price Schedule** = Corbett Account Price Schedule; **Volume Discount** = Corbett Volume Discount Agreement; **Category Contract** = Corbett Category Contract; **Net-Price** = Corbett Net-Price Contract; **Cost-Plus** = Corbett Cost-Plus Contract; **Strategic Supply** = Corbett Strategic Supply Agreement.

## Rebate terms by tier

| Term | Account Price Schedule | Volume Discount | Category Contract | Net-Price | Cost-Plus | Strategic Supply |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Earns a quarterly volume rebate | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Rebate measurement period | calendar quarter | calendar quarter | calendar quarter | calendar quarter | calendar quarter | calendar quarter |
| What counts toward qualifying spend and commitment spend | net shipped merchandise less returns | net shipped merchandise less returns | net shipped merchandise less returns | net shipped merchandise less returns | net shipped merchandise less returns | net shipped merchandise less returns |
| Special-order lines excluded from qualifying spend | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Calendar days after the period end by which the rebate is paid | 0 | 0 | 0 | 45 | 45 | 30 |
| Payout methods the customer may choose | credit memo | credit memo | credit memo | credit memo | credit memo | credit memo or check |
| Smallest rebate balance paid out at a period end (USD); a smaller balance carries forward | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 250.00 | 250.00 | 100.00 |
| Returns of merchandise counted in a paid or accrued period reduce the rebate | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Rebate accrued and unpaid is forfeited when the customer terminates early | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Rebate ladders

The rate of the highest bracket the quarter's qualifying spend reaches applies to the whole quarter's qualifying spend; spend below the first bracket earns nothing.

| Tier | Quarterly qualifying spend brackets (rate applied to the whole quarter's qualifying spend) |
|---|---|
| Corbett Account Price Schedule | no ladder; no rebate |
| Corbett Volume Discount Agreement | no ladder; no rebate |
| Corbett Category Contract | no ladder; no rebate |
| Corbett Net-Price Contract | from 62500.00 USD: 0.5 percent; from 125000.00 USD: 1 percent |
| Corbett Cost-Plus Contract | from 250000.00 USD: 0.5 percent; from 500000.00 USD: 1 percent |
| Corbett Strategic Supply Agreement | from 750000.00 USD: 1 percent; from 1250000.00 USD: 1.5 percent; from 2000000.00 USD: 2 percent |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical ladder)

Under a hypothetical ladder of 1 percent from 100000.00 and 2 percent from 200000.00, a quarter with 150000.00 of qualifying spend reaches the first bracket only and earns 1 percent of the whole 150000.00, which is 1500.00; a quarter with 99999.99 earns nothing. These brackets are illustrative, not a tier ladder.
